content:
<svg width="600" height="300" viewBox="0 0 600 300"
     xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

  <defs>
    <!-- Body gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="bodyGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#f3f3f3"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#dbdbdb"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Joystick knob gradient -->
    <radialGradient id="stickGrad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#777"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#333"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- Gloss overlay for buttons -->
    <radialGradient id="btnGloss" cx="30%" cy="30%" r="70%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fff" stop-opacity="0.6"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- Central Xbox‑logo gradient -->
    <radialGradient id="logoGrad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#8bbf44"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#5a8c2a"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Controller Body -->
  <path
    d="M60,150
       Q60,50 200,50
       H400
       Q540,50 540,150
       Q540,250 400,250
       H200
       Q60,250 60,150 Z"
    fill="url(#bodyGrad)"
    stroke="#bbb"
    stroke-width="4" />

  <!-- Left Joystick -->
  <g transform="translate(200,150)">
    <circle r="35" fill="#555" />
    <circle r="30" fill="url(#stickGrad)" />
  </g>

  <!-- Right Joystick -->
  <g transform="translate(350,150)">
    <circle r="35" fill="#555" />
    <circle r="30" fill="url(#stickGrad)" />
  </g>

  <!-- D-Pad -->
  <g transform="translate(150,110)">
    <rect x="-30" y="-10" width="60" height="20" rx="5" fill="#888" />
    <rect x="-10" y="-30" width="20" height="60" rx="5" fill="#888" />
  </g>

  <!-- A/B/X/Y Buttons -->
  <!-- X Button -->
  <g transform="translate(440,110)">
    <circle r="18" fill="#3b81c8" />
    <circle r="18" fill="url(#btnGloss)" />
    <text x="0" y="6" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif"
          font-size="18px" fill="#fff">X</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Y Button -->
  <g transform="translate(480,90)">
    <circle r="18" fill="#c8b13b" />
    <circle r="18" fill="url(#btnGloss)" />
    <text x="0" y="6" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif"
          font-size="18px" fill="#fff">Y</text>
  </g>
  <!-- B Button -->
  <g transform="translate(520,110)">
    <circle r="18" fill="#c83b3b" />
    <circle r="18" fill="url(#btnGloss)" />
    <text x="0" y="6" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif"
          font-size="18px" fill="#fff">B</text>
  </g>
  <!-- A Button -->
  <g transform="translate(480,130)">
    <circle r="18" fill="#3bc83b" />
    <circle r="18" fill="url(#btnGloss)" />
    <text x="0" y="6" text-anchor="middle" font-family="sans-serif"
          font-size="18px" fill="#fff">A</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Central Xbox Logo Button -->
  <g transform="translate(300,130)">
    <circle r="20" fill="url(#logoGrad)" stroke="#4f6b25" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- Stylized 'X' -->
    <g fill="#fff">
      <rect x="-3" y="-15" width="6" height="30" rx="3" transform="rotate(45)"/>
      <rect x="-3" y="-15" width="6" height="30" rx="3" transform="rotate(-45)"/>
    </g>
  </g>

</svg>

      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#3a3a3a"/>

    <!-- Button Base Gradient -->
     <radialGradient id="buttonBaseGradient" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%" fx="50%" fy="50%">

        <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#1a1a1a"/>

        <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#309030"/>

     <radialGradient id="bButtonGradient" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%" fx="50%" fy="50%">

  <defs>

      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#ff3e2e"/>

    <radialGradient id="btnX" cx="45%" cy="35%" r="60%">

      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2b64b5"/>

    <radialGradient id="btnY" cx="45%" cy="35%" r="60%">

          fill="url(#shoulderGrad)"/>

    <!-- Guide button (Xbox light) -->

        <circle cx="-8" cy="-8" r="2"/>

        <circle cx="8" cy="-8" r="2"/>

        <circle cx="0" cy="-10" r="2"/>
        <circle cx="8" cy="-8" r="2"/>
        <circle cx="16" cy="-2" r="2"/>
        <circle cx="12" cy="8" r="2"/>
        <circle cx="0" cy="10" r="2"/>
        <circle cx="-12" cy="8" r="2"/>

<svg width="800" height="600" viewBox="0 0 800 600" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <!-- Filters for Shadows -->
    <filter id="dropShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="10"/>
      <feOffset dx="0" dy="10" result="offsetblur"/>
      <feComponentTransfer>
        <feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.3"/>
      </feComponentTransfer>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode/>
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>

    <filter id="insetShadow">
      <feOffset dx="0" dy="2"/>
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2" result="offset-blur"/>
      <feComposite operator="out" in="SourceGraphic" in2="offset-blur" result="inverse"/>
      <feFlood flood-color="black" flood-opacity="0.5" result="color"/>
      <feComposite operator="in" in="color" in2="inverse" result="shadow"/>
      <feComposite operator="over" in="shadow" in2="SourceGraphic"/>
    </filter>

    <!-- Gradients -->
    <!-- Body Gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="bodyGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#f2f2f2;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#d9d9d9;stop-opacity:1" />

    <!-- Joystick Gradient -->
    <radialGradient id="stickGrad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%" fx="50%" fy="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#333333;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="80%" style="stop-color:#1a1a1a;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#000000;stop-opacity:1" />

    <radialGradient id="stickTopGrad" cx="50%" cy="30%" r="70%">

      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#1a1a1a;stop-opacity:1" />

    <linearGradient id="buttonGloss" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">

      <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:#ffffff;stop-opacity:0.1" />

    <path d="M 160,60 
             C 160,60 250,40 300,40

             C 450,430 400,350 300,350 
             C 200,350 150,430 120,420 
             C 70,400 20,320 30,200

    <!-- Inner shadow -->
    <filter id="innerShadow" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
      <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="2" result="blur"/>
      <feOffset dx="0" dy="1" result="offsetblur"/>
      <feComposite in2="offsetblur" in="SourceGraphic" operator="out" result="inverse"/>
      <feFlood flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.2" result="color"/>
      <feComposite in="color" in2="inverse" operator="in"/>

      <stop offset="90%" style="stop-color:#1a1a1a;stop-opacity:1" />

    <!-- Joystick Top Texture -->
    <radialGradient id="stickTopGradient" cx="30%" cy="30%" r="70%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#555555;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#222222;stop-opacity:1" />

    <radialGradient id="btnAGradient" cx="30%" cy="30%" r="70%">

      C -80,230 -40,200 -20,180 
      L 20,180 
      C 40,200 80,230 120,220 
      C 180,200 220,120 220,20 
      C 220,-50 200,-90 170,-90

    <path d="

      C 50,150 80,175 110,170

<svg id="xbox-controller" viewBox="0 0 800 550" class="w-full h-full max-h-[80vh] interactive-area no-select" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
            
            <defs>

                    <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#e2e8f0;stop-opacity:1" />

                <linearGradient id="gripGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
                    <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#cbd5e1;stop-opacity:1" />
                    <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#94a3b8;stop-opacity:1" />

                <!-- Button Gradient -->
                <radialGradient id="btnGrad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%" fx="50%" fy="50%">

                    <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#cbd5e1;stop-opacity:1" />
                </radialGradient>

                <!-- Joystick Gradient (Concave effect) -->
                <radialGradient id="stickGrad" cx="50%" cy="40%" r="60%">
                    <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#ffffff;stop-opacity:1" />
                    <stop offset="90%" style="stop-color:#cbd5e1;stop-opacity:1" />
                    <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#94a3b8;stop-opacity:1" />
                </radialGradient>
                
                <!-- Stick Rubber Texture -->
                <pattern id="knurl" x="0" y="0" width="4" height="4" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
                    <circle cx="2" cy="2" r="1" fill="#64748b" opacity="0.2"/>
                </pattern>

                <!-- Drop Shadow Filter -->
                <filter id="shadowFilter" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
                    <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="3" />
                    <feOffset dx="0" dy="4" result="offsetblur" />
                    <feComponentTransfer>
                        <feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.3" />
                    </feComponentTransfer>
                    <feMerge>
                        <feMergeNode />
                        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" />
                    </feMerge>
                </filter>

                <!-- Inner Shadow for sticks -->
                <filter id="innerShadow">
                    <feOffset dx="0" dy="3"/>
                    <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3" result="offset-blur"/>
                    <feComposite operator="out" in="SourceGraphic" in2="offset-blur" result="inverse"/>
                    <feFlood flood-color="black" flood-opacity="0.3" result="color"/>
                    <feComposite operator="in" in="color" in2="inverse" result="shadow"/>
                    <feComposite operator="over" in="shadow" in2="SourceGraphic"/>

            <g id="shoulders">

                <text x="530" y="55" font-size="14" fill="#64748b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" pointer-events="none">RB</text>

            <path id="chassis" 
                  d="M 200,80 
                     C 150,80 80,120 80,250 
                     C 80,450 180,520 240,520 
                     C 300,520 350,480 400,480 
                     C 450,480 500,520 560,520 
                     C 620,520 720,450 720,250 
                     C 720,120 650,80 600,80

                  fill="url(#bodyGrad)" 
                  stroke="#cbd5e1" 
                  stroke-width="2"
                  filter="url(#shadowFilter)"

      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#5dc264"/>

      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#e85454"/>

      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#5b9bd5"/>
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#3a6fa0"/>

    <!-- Y button (yellow) -->

      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#f0c040"/>

content:
<svg width="600" height="400" viewBox="0 0 600 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <!-- Main Body Gradient (Matte Black) -->
    <linearGradient id="bodyGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#2b2b2b;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:#3a3a3a;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#2b2b2b;stop-opacity:1" />
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Top Plate Gradient (Slightly Glossy) -->
    <linearGradient id="topPlateGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#4a4a4a;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#2f2f2f;stop-opacity:1" />
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Xbox Button Gradient (Green) -->
    <radialGradient id="xboxGradient" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%" fx="50%" fy="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#85c056;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="60%" style="stop-color:#6da044;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#4e7a30;stop-opacity:1" />
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- Stick Shaft Gradient (Matte Dark) -->
    <linearGradient id="stickShaftGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#222;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:#444;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#222;stop-opacity:1" />
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Stick Top Gradient (Glossy Black) -->
    <radialGradient id="stickTopGradient" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%" fx="40%" fy="40%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#555;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="40%" style="stop-color:#2a2a2a;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#000;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#1a1a1a;stop-opacity:1" /> <!-- Outer rim darker -->
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- Bumpers/Triggers Gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="bumperGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#3e3e3e;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#262626;stop-opacity:1" />
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Shadow Gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="shadowGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#000000;stop-opacity:0.4" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#000000;stop-opacity:0" />
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Drop Shadow for the whole controller -->
  <g filter="url(#shadowFilter)">
    <!-- Controller Base Shape -->
    <path d="M 100 100 L 500 100 Q 560 100 560 160 L 560 240 Q 560 320 500 320 L 100 320 Q 40 320 40 260 L 40 160 Q 40 100 100 100 Z" 
          fill="url(#bodyGradient)" stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="2" />

    <!-- Top Plate (The "Bridge") -->
    <path d="M 200 100 L 400 100 L 400 140 L 200 140 Z" 
          fill="url(#topPlateGradient)" stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="1" />

    <!-- Left Bumper/Trigger Area -->
    <path d="M 100 100 L 160 60 L 220 60 L 200 100 Z" fill="url(#bumperGradient)" stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="1" />
    <path d="M 100 320 L 160 360 L 220 360 L 200 320 Z" fill="url(#bumperGradient)" stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="1" />

    <!-- Right Bumper/Trigger Area -->
    <path d="M 500 100 L 440 60 L 380 60 L 400 100 Z" fill="url(#bumperGradient)" stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="1" />
    <path d="M 500 320 L 440 360 L 380 360 L 400 320 Z" fill="url(#bumperGradient)" stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="1" />

    <!-- Connection Port (Bottom) -->
    <rect x="270" y="330" width="60" height="15" fill="#111" />

    <!-- D-PAD (Left Side) -->
    <g transform="translate(230, 180)">
      <!-- Outer Ring -->
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="32" fill="#222" stroke="#444" stroke-width="2" />
      <!--十字键形状 -->
      <path d="M -32 0 L -10 0 L -10 -25 L -35 -25 L -35 25 L -10 25 L -10 0 L 0 0 L 0 10 L -25 10 L -25 35 L 25 35 L 25 10 L 0 10 L 0 0 L 10 0 L 10 -25 L 35 -25 L 35 25 L 10 25 L 10 0 L 32 0" fill="#333" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1" />
      <!-- D-PAD Center Cap -->
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="8" fill="url(#stickShaftGradient)" />
    </g>

    <!-- Start & Select Buttons -->
    <g transform="translate(300, 125)">
      <!-- Start -->
      <ellipse cx="25" cy="0" rx="10" ry="7" fill="#444" stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="1" />
      <text x="25" y="4" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="6" text-anchor="middle" fill="#aaa" style="letter-spacing: 1px;">START</text>
      <!-- Select -->
      <ellipse cx="-25" cy="0" rx="10" ry="7" fill="#444" stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="1" />
      <text x="-25" y="4" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="6" text-anchor="middle" fill="#aaa" style="letter-spacing: 1px;">SELECT</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Xbox Logo Button -->
    <g transform="translate(300, 155)">
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="16" fill="url(#xboxGradient)" stroke="#3e7a30" stroke-width="1" />
      <path d="M -6 -6 L -6 6 M -6 -6 L 6 6 M 6 -6 L -6 6 M 6 -6 L 6 6" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2" stroke-opacity="0.6" />
      <!-- The Four Buttons -->
      <g transform="translate(0, 5)">
        <circle cx="15" cy="-15" r="5" fill="#c74a3b" /> <!-- A (Red) -->
        <circle cx="25" cy="-5" r="5" fill="#4a9ac7" /> <!-- B (Blue) -->
        <circle cx="15" cy="5" r="5" fill="#4ac76a" /> <!-- X (Green) -->
        <circle cx="5" cy="-5" r="5" fill="#e5c437" /> <!-- Y (Yellow) -->
        
        <!-- Button Highlights (Subtle 3D effect) -->
        <circle cx="15" cy="-15" r="3" fill="white" fill-opacity="0.3" />
        <circle cx="25" cy="-5" r="3" fill="white" fill-opacity="0.3" />
        <circle cx="15" cy="5" r="3" fill="white" fill-opacity="0.3" />
        <circle cx="5" cy="-5" r="3" fill="white" fill-opacity="0.3" />
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- Right Joystick (Right Side) -->
    <g transform="translate(430, 210)">
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="35" fill="url(#stickShaftGradient)" stroke="#111" stroke-width="2" />
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="28" fill="url(#stickTopGradient)" />
      <!-- Stick Highlight -->
      <circle cx="-8" cy="-8" r="10" fill="white" fill-opacity="0.1" />
      <circle cx="5" cy="5" r="15" fill="black" fill-opacity="0.2" />
    </g>

    <!-- Left Joystick (Left Side) -->
    <g transform="translate(170, 210)">
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="35" fill="url(#stickShaftGradient)" stroke="#111" stroke-width="2" />
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="28" fill="url(#stickTopGradient)" />
      <!-- Stick Highlight -->
      <circle cx="-8" cy="-8" r="10" fill="white" fill-opacity="0.1" />
      <circle cx="5" cy="5" r="15" fill="black" fill-opacity="0.2" />
      
      <!-- Joystick Cap Texture Lines -->
      <path d="M -15 -5 L 15 -5" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1" stroke-opacity="0.3" />
      <path d="M -15 0 L 15 0" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1" stroke-opacity="0.3" />
      <path d="M -15 5 L 15 5" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1" stroke-opacity="0.3" />
      <path d="M -5 -15 L -5 15" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1" stroke-opacity="0.3" />
      <path d="M 0 -15 L 0 15" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1" stroke-opacity="0.3" />
      <path d="M 5 -15 L 5 15" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1" stroke-opacity="0.3" />
    </g>

    <!-- Right Stick Button (Thumstick Click) -->
    <circle cx="430" cy="210" r="12" fill="#222" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1" />
    <circle cx="430" cy="210" r="6" fill="#444" />

    <!-- Left Stick Button (Thumstick Click) -->
    <circle cx="170" cy="210" r="12" fill="#222" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1" />
    <circle cx="170" cy="210" r="6" fill="#444" />

    <!-- Sync Button (Small circle near top) -->
    <g transform="translate(300, 85)">
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="6" fill="#333" stroke="#111" stroke-width="1" />
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="3" fill="#555" />
      <text x="0" y="10" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="5" text-anchor="middle" fill="#666">SYNC</text>
    </g>

  </g>

  <!-- Filter Definition for the shadow -->
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadowFilter" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.5"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>
</svg>

<svg viewBox="0 0 400 280" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>

      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#2a2a2a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1a1a1a"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Button gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="buttonGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#4a4a4a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2a2a2a"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Joystick gradient -->
    <radialGradient id="joystickGrad" cx="40%" cy="40%">

    <!-- D-pad gradient -->

      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#3d3d3d"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#252525"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Xbox button gradient -->
    <radialGradient id="xboxBtnGrad" cx="50%" cy="30%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#c0c0c0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    
    <!-- Trigger gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="triggerGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#2d2d2d"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1a1a1a"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Colored button gradients -->
    <radialGradient id="greenBtn" cx="40%" cy="40%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#5ed65e"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2d8b2d"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="redBtn" cx="40%" cy="40%">

      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2b5cc4"/>

      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#c4a82b"/>
    </radialGradient>
    
    <!-- Grip texture pattern -->
    <pattern id="gripPattern" width="4" height="4" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">

    <!-- Shadow filter -->

      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#000" flood-opacity="0.4"/>

      <feFlood flood-color="#000" flood-opacity="0.3" result="color"/>
      <feComposite operator="in" in="color" in2="inverse" result="shadow"/>

  <path d="M345 200 Q355 220 350 245 Q340 265 310 270"

  <!-- Grip textures -->

  <ellipse cx="330" cy="220" rx="20" ry="35" fill="url(#gripPattern)" opacity="0.3"/>
  
  <!-- Left bumper (LB) -->

  <defs>

    <linearGradient id="bodyGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#eaeaea"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#d0d0d0"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Subtle highlight on top edge -->
    <linearGradient id="topHighlight" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.4"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Joystick base gradient -->
    <radialGradient id="joyBaseGrad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#f5f5f5"/>
      <stop offset="70%"  stop-color="#e0e0e0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#c8c8c8"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- Joystick stick gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="joyStickGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#bbbbbb"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#999999"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Button base gradient -->
    <radialGradient id="btnBaseGrad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#ffffff"/>
      <stop offset="70%"  stop-color="#e6e6e6"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#cccccc"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- Button press (inner) gradient -->
    <radialGradient id="btnPressGrad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#f0f0f0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#d8d8d8"/>
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- Trigger gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="triggerGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#e0e0e0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#c8c8c8"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- D‑pad base -->
    <linearGradient id="dpadGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#f2f2f2"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#d9d9d9"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- ==== Controller Body ==== -->
  <g id="controller">
    <!-- Main rounded rectangle -->
    <rect x="20" y="40" width="360" height="200" rx="30" ry="30"
          fill="url(#bodyGrad)" stroke="#b0b0b0" stroke-width="2"/>

    <!-- Top highlight for a subtle shine -->
    <path d="M20,40             q30,0 30,30
             h300
             q30,0 30,30
             v20
             h-360
             v-20
             q0,-30 30,-30z"
          fill="url(#topHighlight)"/>

    <!-- Left grip -->
    <path d="M20,140

    <path d="M360,140

    <!-- ==== Left Analog Stick ==== -->
    <g id="leftStick" transform="translate(80,130)">
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="20" fill="url(#joyBaseGrad)" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="8" fill="url(#joyStickGrad)" stroke="#777" stroke-width="1"/>
    </g>

    <!-- ==== Right Analog Stick ==== -->
    <g id="rightStick" transform="translate(260,100)">
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="20" fill="url(#joyBaseGrad)" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="8" fill="url(#joyStickGrad)" stroke="#777" stroke-width="1"/>
    </g>

    <!-- ==== D‑Pad ==== -->
    <g id="dpad" transform="translate(80,100)">

      <!-- Down -->
      <polygon points="0,8   -4,0   4,0"
               fill="#666"/>
      <!-- Left -->
      <polygon points="-8,0   0,-4   0,4"
               fill="#666"/>
      <!-- Right -->
      <polygon points="8,0    0,-4   0,4"

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" height="100%">

      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#d1d5db"/>

      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#e5e7eb"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#9ca3af"/>

    <!-- Bumper & Trigger Gradients -->
    <linearGradient id="bumperGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">

      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#9ca3af"/>

    <linearGradient id="triggerGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#4b5563"/>

    <!-- D-Pad Gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="dpadGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">

    <radialGradient id="stickTop" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">

      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#1f2937"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#111827"/>

    <!-- Filters -->
    <filter id="dropShadow" x="-10%" y="-10%" width="130%" height="130%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="15" stdDeviation="20" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.5"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="innerShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feOffset dx="0" dy="4"/>
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="5" result="offset-blur"/>
      <feComposite operator="out" in="SourceGraphic" in2="offset-blur" result="inverse"/>
      <feFlood flood-color="black" flood-opacity="0.5" result="color"/>
      <feComposite operator="in" in="color" in2="inverse" result="shadow"/>
      <feComposite operator="over" in="shadow" in2="SourceGraphic"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="glow" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="6" result="blur"/>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in="blur"/>
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>

    <filter id="btnShadow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%">

    <!-- Top Gloss Highlights -->

    <path d="M 270 160 C 220 170, 190 200, 200 260 C 202 270, 205 280, 210 290 C 205 250, 220 200, 260 180 Z" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.5"/>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="800" height="600">

    <!-- Body highlight -->

      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#4a4f57" stop-opacity="0.8"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#4a4f57" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Joystick gradient -->
    <radialGradient id="joystickGradient" cx="35%" cy="35%" r="65%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#4a4f57"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#2a2d33"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0a0c0e"/>
    </radialGradient>
    
    <!-- Joystick top -->

      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#2a2d33"/>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" height="100%">

        <line x1="-4.5" y1="0" x2="4.5" y2="0" stroke="#8e9aac" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <line x1="-4.5" y1="3.5" x2="4.5" y2="3.5" stroke="#8e9aac" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      </g>

      <!-- SHARE BUTTON (Modern Series X Center Button) -->

        <rect x="-7.5" y="-9" width="15" height="18" rx="5" fill="#101318"/>

    <!-- 9. STATUS LED ACCENT -->

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 350" width="400" height="350">
  <defs>

    <linearGradient id="bodyGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#2C2C2C;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#111111;stop-opacity:1" />
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Trigger Gradients -->
    <linearGradient id="lbGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#FF3333;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#CC0000;stop-opacity:1" />
    </linearGradient>
    
    <linearGradient id="rbGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#00C700;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#006400;stop-opacity:1" />
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Button Gradients -->
    <linearGradient id="aGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#FF5733;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#CC0000;stop-opacity:1" />
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="bGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#00E676;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#00CC00;stop-opacity:1" />
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="xAGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#FF5733;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#CC0000;stop-opacity:1" />
    </linearGradient>

    <linearGradient id="xBGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#00E676;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#00CC00;stop-opacity:1" />
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Drop Shadow -->
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feGaussianBlur in="SourceAlpha" stdDeviation="3"/>
      <feOffset dx="2" dy="4" result="offsetblur"/>
      <feComponentTransfer>
        <feFuncA type="linear" slope="0.3"/>
      </feComponentTransfer>
      <feMerge> 
        <feMergeNode in="offsetblur"/> 
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/> 
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="400" height="350" fill="#1a1a1a"/>

  <!-- Main Body -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <path d="M 200 80 Q 180 130 200 180 Q 220 130 200 170 L 200 260 Q 180 270 200 280 Q 220 270 200 260 L 220 250 Q 200 240 200 270 Z" 
          fill="url(#bodyGrad)" stroke="#444" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- Body Bezel -->
    <rect x="160" y="60" width="80" height="40" rx="5" fill="#3a3a3a" stroke="#555" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Left Trigger (LB) -->

      <feOffset dx="0" dy="3"/>
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3" result="offset-blur"/>
      <feComposite operator="out" in="SourceGraphic" in2="offset-blur" result="inverse"/>
      <feFlood flood-color="black" flood-opacity="0.7" result="color"/>
      <feComposite operator="in" in="color" in2="inverse" result="shadow"/>
